user.title: Connect to GitHub
user.description: Connect a GitHub repository. Use a fine-grained personal access token scoped to this repository with **Actions**, **Issues** and **Pull requests** read & write permissions.

data_description.token: Stored in the Home Assistant configuration entry, not in secrets.yaml.
data_description.api_url: Defaults to the public GitHub API. Point this at a GitHub Enterprise server if needed.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate GitHub Manager
reauth_confirm.description: The stored token no longer works. Enter a new fine-grained personal access token for `{repo}`.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the GitHub API.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed — check the token and its permissions.
error.invalid_repo: Repository not found (use owner/name) or the token cannot see it.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — see the Home Assistant logs.

data_description.poll_interval: How often workflow runs, issues and pull requests are refreshed (minimum 30 seconds).
